title: EnvironmentReading
description: One environment sample from the ESP32, normalised by the bridge from a sensor_report and published on sensor.environment. A value is null when that sensor failed in this cycle.

ts.description: Sample time, ISO 8601 UTC, as stamped by the Pi on receipt.

temperature_c.description: Air temperature, degrees Celsius, one decimal place, -40.0 to 85.0, null on sensor fault.

humidity_pct.description: Relative humidity, percent, integer 0 to 100, null on sensor fault.

lux.description: Ambient illuminance at the light sensor, lux, integer 0 to 100000, null on sensor fault.
